description: This file defines the Helpers class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static helper methods for date and time calculations, conversions, and validations used in spreadsheet date/time handling.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods for date and time calculations, conversions, error handling, and validation within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDateValue
methods.description: Converts a date input into an Excel serial number, handling various input types and validation.

methods.name: getTimeValue
methods.description: Converts a time string into an Excel serial number.

methods.name: adjustDateByMonths
methods.description: Adjusts a given date by a specified number of months, returning a DateTime object.

methods.name: replaceIfEmpty
methods.description: Replaces a variable's value with an alternative if it is empty.

methods.name: adjustYear
methods.description: Adjusts the year in ambiguous date representations based on heuristics.

methods.name: returnIn3FormatsArray
methods.description: Returns a date in one of three formats: PHP DateTime, Excel serial, or Unix timestamp.

methods.name: returnIn3FormatsFloat
methods.description: Returns an Excel date as one of three formats depending on the return type setting.

methods.name: returnIn3FormatsObject
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object or its equivalent in other formats based on display settings.

methods.name: baseDate
methods.description: Provides the base date offset depending on the calendar mode.

methods.name: nullFalseTrueToNumber
methods.description: Converts null/false/true values to a numeric representation for date calculations.

methods.name: validateNumericNull
methods.description: Ensures an input is numeric or null, throwing an exception otherwise.

methods.name: validateNotNegative
methods.description: Validates that a number is non-negative.

methods.name: silly1900
methods.description: Adjusts dates prior to 1900-03-01 for compatibility quirks.

methods.name: dateParse
methods.description: Parses a date string into an array of date components.

methods.name: dateParseSucceeded
methods.description: Checks if date parsing succeeded based on error count.

methods.name: forceArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is returned as an array, providing a default error array if not.
